facts.value: The Study Service Point and hotline are your central contact points for questions regarding study, application, and student administration.
The central study advising supports you competently with all issues related to studying.
Discover support services for your individual educational path.
The student secretariat is your reliable contact for all questions regarding the organization of your studies.
In the examination offices, you will find contacts for all formal matters regarding your academic performance.
The Goethe University accompanies international students with comprehensive consulting and service offerings throughout their journey from application to graduation.
Mental health in focus: Learn strategies for stress management and self-care for a relaxed and motivated study day.
The Psychotherapeutic Counseling Center (PBS) offers you support and a listening ear for personal concerns.
The Psychosocial Counseling Center supports students with personal and study-related challenges.
The University Sports Center (ZfH) offers a diverse sports program and courses for stress management and self-assertion.
Our Career Service supports you in career orientation and offers workshops, coaching, and networks to strengthen your career competence.
The Career Service supports graduates (up to 1 year after graduation) in their career entry.
Goethe University promotes an equitable and anti-discriminatory environment and stands for equality, diversity, and inclusion.
The student service provides affordable housing near the campus.
Get information about rent prices and apply online for your room.
The student services inform about all options for financing studies, such as BAföG, scholarships, part-time jobs, or loans.
